Returned Lakhnaur mauza code 0768, Cadastral Survey, CS Map and sheet choices.
Returned 12 nonempty sheet extents for Lakhnaur Cadastral Survey / CS Map, CRS EPSG:32645, with gisCodes such as CS05031307682470601 through CS05031307682470612.

The exact WUP point was not force-matched to a sheet or parcel. Its EPSG:32645 coordinate is approximately x=433390.2275, y=2899913.8681; the closest returned sheet-04 extent ends at x=434061.48, y=2899843.26, so the point is just north of that extent. No zero-hit inference is made.

blocker: The official service exposed map-sheet extents but the exact WUP point was outside the returned Lakhnaur sheet envelopes by a small margin, and no parcel geometry/ID response was obtained. This is a bounded map-extent limitation, not evidence of citywide absence.
remainingUncertainty: The WUP point may represent a broader Lakhnaur locality or lie outside the specific mauza map extents returned by the viewer. Parcel coverage beyond the selected mauza and any local urban/rural boundary mismatch remain unverified.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently qualify any parcel-level adapter only after obtaining a safe native parcel ID plus full polygon from the official viewer/API, with geographic validation against the saved WUP point.
